reviews.comment: Prof Shandley is such a nice man, very lighthearted, and cares about what he does. He did change the syllabus a few times BUT was always very transparent and made sure to do it at his cost not the students. He moved several classes to zoom and overall is just a really flexible guy - this class is not hard.

Terrible at giving clear deadlines and sticking to them. He changed syllabus 3 times, settled on 4 papers, and then decided to change it to 3 papers on a whim the day the third paper was supposed to be due (I think it's because he didn't prepare the prompts for paper 3 on time).

He may just be bad for this class, but I'll never take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He provides all of the readings and while you do have to read them, they're usually interesting. Grades are based on weekly writing assignments and a final paper over a topic of your choice- no tests. Lectures provide good insight into the weekly responses. He is interesting and very well versed on the subject.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Shandley is very caring and sweet. There's a ton of readings for the course but the material is interesting. You're graded off of weekly responses and a 10 page paper at the end of the course. He knows a lot about the subject and picks good material to discuss.
Not that bad. Seminar was pretty boring but i think it was the other students. i didnt like the topic but there's nothing you can do about it.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The senior seminar class was terrible. Terrible topic, boring readings, nobody really participated, i hated the class and im glad its over. Didn't learn much. Why do we have to read so much for the exams and for class readings when 45% of your grade is outside research? Avoid this class and pick a seminar with an interesting professor
